decision: Use active-only retrieval by default. Runbooks are replace-in-place projections of the latest validated procedure; incidents, cases, checkpoints and superseded sources are preserved in historical paths and loaded only through explicit Intent opt-in.
rationale: The separation lowers token cost and stale-context risk while retaining auditability, reconstruction and rollback.
alternatives: rely on semantic similarity without lifecycle metadata
authority_source: Explicit builder request on 2026-10-01 to update APOS in Valora, Product Platform Kit and leo-brain.
scope: Repository documentation, context compiler and reusable starter; no release or external service effect.
